facts.text: The head can be set from MIN_HEAD_ANGLE (util.degrees(-25)) to MAX_HEAD_ANGLE (util.degrees(44.5))
SetHeadAngle clamps a head target to MIN_HEAD_ANGLE..MAX_HEAD_ANGLE and logs a warning
The head angle is received from the robot in radians and stored as a util.Angle
set_head_angle returns a SetHeadAngle action object that can be queried to see when it is complete
set_lift_height takes a ratio from 0.0 (bottom) to 1.0 (top) and clamps it to that range
SetLiftHeight converts the ratio to millimetres between MIN_LIFT_HEIGHT_MM and MAX_LIFT_HEIGHT_MM
The lift height is reported in millimetres and the lift ratio from 0.0 to 1.0
stop_all_motors tells the robot to stop all motors
An action can be polled with is_completed and awaited with wait_for_completed(timeout)
